en_title: Xbox Will Reportedly Continue to Support Physical Discs Following PS6 Backlash
cn_title: XBOX据称继续支持实体光盘
subtitle: 向后兼容优先
opus_summary: Digital Foundry的John Linneman称，消息人士透露微软计划继续支持实体游戏光盘，重点是让玩家在新XBOX主机上继续游玩已有游戏。

quality_review.review_notes: Independent bilingual self-review completed for coverage, attribution, uncertainty, numbers, dates, currency, units, names, media, and natural Chinese news style.

paragraphs.en: Digital Foundry's John Linneman says sources have told him that Microsoft is planning to continue support for physical game discs with the aim of prioritizing backward compatibility.
paragraphs.cn: Digital Foundry的John Linneman表示，消息人士告诉他，微软计划继续支持实体游戏光盘，目标是优先保障向后兼容。

paragraphs.en: The topic came up during a Digital Foundry Q&A video posted to YouTube on July 31, where Linneman raised the optimistic possibility that discs might not be going the way of the dinosaur, at least on Xbox’s side of things.
paragraphs.cn: 在7月31日发布的Digital Foundry问答视频中，Linneman提到了一个乐观的可能性：至少就XBOX而言，光盘或许不会像恐龙一样走向灭绝。

paragraphs.en: However, the reason for this isn’t necessarily due to sales numbers; rather, Linneman says that backward compatibility is a bigger priority.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这么做的原因未必是销量；Linneman表示，向后兼容是更重要的优先事项。

paragraphs.en: "I'd heard from a couple sort of sources — and this is just kind of like potential rumor-y stuff — but at least, before the current Xbox reset, I don't know where it is now, it sounds like Microsoft was actually very much going to continue disc support. Not because they value retail disc sales, but because they wanted to ensure that all your Xbox games were still playable on new Xboxes,” he explained.
paragraphs.cn: 「我从几个消息人士那里听说过一些情况——这基本只是可能属于传闻的内容——但至少在目前的XBOX重启之前，我不知道现在情况如何，听起来微软确实非常打算继续支持光盘。不是因为他们看重零售光盘销量，而是因为他们希望确保你的所有XBOX游戏仍能在新XBOX主机上运行。」他解释道。

paragraphs.en: He went on to envision a future where, in stark contrast to Sony’s future plans, Xbox doubles down on preserving physical media, even hinting at ties to Microsoft’s possible plans to digitize players’ physical game libraries.
paragraphs.cn: 随后，他设想了一个未来：与索尼的未来计划形成鲜明对比，XBOX会加倍保护实体媒介，甚至暗示这可能与微软将玩家实体游戏库数字化的计划有关。

paragraphs.en: "And it's like, 'We could offer maybe like an external drive,' or basically some means, and I think that might all tie into this disc-to-digital stuff, as well. But I get this feeling that they might actually, especially given their reaction — I'm not saying they're going to solve problems or anything drastically going to change — but I do see a future where Microsoft actually supports discs going forward, for users that want to take their library with them, while Sony just completely cuts people off."
paragraphs.cn: 「比如，我们可以提供某种外置光驱」，或者基本上以某种方式实现；我认为这也可能与光盘转数字内容有关。不过我有一种感觉，尤其考虑到他们的反应，他们实际上可能会支持光盘继续存在——我不是说他们会解决问题，或者会发生什么巨大改变——但我确实看到了这样的未来：微软会继续支持那些希望带着自己的游戏库走的用户使用光盘，而索尼则会彻底切断玩家与游戏库的联系。」

paragraphs.en: While nothing has been officially confirmed by Xbox or Microsoft themselves, these reports come as welcome news to players in the wake of Sony’s hotly-debated decision to end the production of physical game discs starting January 2028.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管XBOX或微软官方都未确认任何消息，但在索尼引发热议的决定之后，这些报道对玩家而言无疑是个好消息：索尼决定从2028年1月开始停止生产实体游戏光盘。

paragraphs.en: The company hasn’t backed down on this choice in spite of the massive backlash it’s received, either, with Sony’s Chief Financial Officer Lin Tao doubling down on killing discs in a first quarter fiscal results Q&A for investors in late July.
paragraphs.cn: 即使遭到巨大反弹，索尼也没有在这一选择上退缩。索尼首席财务官Lin Tao在7月下旬面向投资者的第一季度财报问答中，再次强调要终止光盘。

paragraphs.en: “We’re going to cautiously move this forward,” she said. “And to this decision, we have received various opinions and people have strong views, and we understand that the community has put forth those views to us. Games are loved by many people. It’s a form of entertainment that’s loved by people, and it’s connected to people’s fond memories in many cases.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们会谨慎推进这件事。」她说，「关于这一决定，我们收到了各种意见，很多人有强烈看法，也了解社区已将这些看法传达给我们。很多人都喜爱游戏。这是一种许多人喜爱的娱乐形式，在很多情况下，它与人们的美好回忆相连。」

paragraphs.en: “And so we understand those emotions. We want to consider that. And in the future digital ecosystem, how do we engage the gamers is something that we would like to continue to explore.”
paragraphs.cn: 「因此，我们理解这些情绪，也希望考虑到这一点。在未来的数字生态中，我们该如何与玩家互动，是我们希望继续探索的事情。」

paragraphs.en: Linneman’s latest comments follow optimistic remarks from Xbox’s Chief Technology Officer Scott Van Vliet following a network outage late last month. After hearing reports of players being unable to access their physical games during the outage, Vliet said that “disc-based entitlement checks should not prevent players from accessing their games, and this is by design ,” something that set players’ minds at ease at least for a short while.
paragraphs.cn: Linneman最新的评论是在XBOX首席技术官Scott Van Vliet上月底网络中断后发表乐观言论之后出现的。听到玩家在中断期间无法访问实体游戏的消息后，Vliet表示，「基于光盘的权益验证不应阻止玩家访问自己的游戏，这是设计如此」，这至少在短时间内让玩家安心。

paragraphs.en: This is the latest Xbox news to stir up conversation among enthusiasts after a leaked document reportedly laid out plans to bring Xbox 360 games to both PC and its next-generation console, Project Helix, with a potential rollout slated for 2027-2028.
paragraphs.cn: 这是最新一则引发爱好者讨论的XBOX新闻。此前有泄露文件据称列出了将XBOX 360游戏带到PC及下一代主机Project Helix的计划，预计可能在2027至2028年推出。
